name: Berserk 1997
summary: Blocky simplified late-90s TV cels in earthy medieval browns and steel greys, punctuated by fully painted still frames and slow pans.

traits.line: thick dark lines on blocky simplified forms, far fewer lines than Miura's hatched manga
traits.shading: flat hard cel shadow, minimal tones; detail moved into painted stills
traits.palette: earthy desaturated medieval tones: mud brown, steel grey, olive, straw, dried-blood red; crimson eclipse sky
traits.lighting: dim torchlight and candlelight, overcast fields, firelit camps
traits.faces: square jaws, heavy brows, simple eyes; white-haired glossy Griffith versus scarred Guts
traits.camera: limited animation: held stills with camera pans where only a mouth or candle moves; action cut to fully painted detailed frames

style_words: Late-1990s low-budget TV cel animation, as in Berserk (1997): thick dark lines on blocky simplified forms, flat hard cel shadow, earthy desaturated medieval palette of mud brown, steel grey, olive and dried-blood red, dim torch and candle light, fully painted illustration-like still frames, matte painted castle backgrounds, cel grain.
avoid: Miura-manga dense cross-hatching (that is the manga, not this anime)

krea2.style: Late-1990s low-budget TV cel animation, as in the 1997 Berserk: thick dark lines on blocky simplified forms, flat hard cel shadow in solid shapes, earthy desaturated medieval mud brown, steel grey, olive, straw and dried-blood red, dim torch and candle light, matte hand-painted backgrounds, cel grain and soft video blur.
krea2.recap: Rendered throughout as late-1990s TV cel animation with thick dark lines and cel grain.

flux3_klein.style: Late-1990s TV anime cel animation in the register of the 1997 Berserk TV series: thick dark outlines on blocky simplified forms with few interior lines, flat hard cel shadow in a single tone, square jaws, heavy brows and simple eyes, matte opaque cel paint, fully painted illustration-like matte backgrounds, cel grain and video softness.
flux3_klein.recap: Mud brown, steel grey and olive fill the walls, the ground and the shadow fills, straw yellow stays inside torch, candle and lamp light, dried-blood red appears only low in the sky, and every garment keeps its own stated colour.

qwen_image_2_1.style: The image is a late-1990s TV cel animation frame in a signature Berserk (1997) style, with thick dark lines on blocky simplified forms, flat, unmodulated colour fills and hard-edged shadow shapes with minimal tones, matte painted illustration-like backgrounds, cel grain and soft video haze, depicting a scene from a Gothic Victorian novel in a palette of earthy desaturated mud brown, steel grey, olive, straw and dried-blood red.
qwen_image_2_1.recap: The overall composition holds its blocky forms still like a painted frame, weighted by dim light and heavy flat shadow, with a grim medieval mood, keeps to a palette of earthy desaturated mud brown, steel grey, olive, straw and dried-blood red, and reads throughout as a late-1990s TV cel animation frame in a signature Berserk (1997) style, with thick dark lines on blocky simplified forms, flat, unmodulated colour fills and hard-edged shadow shapes with minimal tones, matte painted illustration-like backgrounds, cel grain and soft video haze.
